attempt: stroke features for all 4,164 dog doodles (aspect, mirror symmetry, top-band mass by side, top profile by thirds, leg runs, leg rows); automatic classes; contact sheets
saw: classes are rough: "lie" pool full of front faces with floppy ears, many side views mislabeled; facing guess usable
decision: automatic classes only narrow the search; poses are labelled by eye from sheets (auto-*, pool-lie-*, short-*)

attempt: picked 45 dogs of one construction family (round or floppy-eared head, oval/box body, stick legs): 27 standing/crouching, 3 front/sitting, 15 lying; labelled facing, posture, head, leg spread, face-to-viewer, rest
saw: lying dogs are rare (about 15 usable among the ~180 widest drawings looked at); facing labels agree with a stroke-measured head-side guess on 40/42
decision: allow a rigid mirror per candidate (doubles facings without bending)

attempt: house #36, door, moon, face, hands, stairs, tree, fence from their category files
saw: house #36 walls lower than a 2 m door
decision: house #3 (box + roof, no door of its own), larger than frame so the roof crops

attempt: Viterbi over 87 candidates x hold counter, on twos; emission from act values
saw: approach swap at 15.08 s (+0.37), lie at 24.0 (+0.21): the act values ease, the decoder followed them
decision: state-keyed targets: from the frame the state changes, the target is the new state pose

attempt: turning windows at 3.42 and 7.46 s demanding a front / face-to-viewer drawing
saw: at 3.42 the dog showed a front-sitting drawing until 3.83: the 3.6 s still showed no turned back; the refusal was averaged into a front view
decision: removed the 3.42 window (cut straight to the back, the protected key pose); kept 7.46 where sitting up facing us then standing reads as turning back to look

saw: door frame stuck out past the slanted house wall; tree cluttered the steps; voice arcs too small to see; low hand short of the doorway
decision: house moved right and lit interior clipped at the jamb; tree removed; arcs enlarged; hand set into the doorway

saw: invariants 1, 3, 4 held; lying drawings jumped 0.125 m between substitutions (bbox-centre registration); dog small in the wide frame; title subtitle ran off the card
decision: register each drawing by its ink centroid; dog sizes +15%; wrap title

attempt: spectrogram + RMS per 0.5 s (no listening possible here)
saw: pencil scratch broadband and loud, calls 20-26% RMS vs 1-9% elsewhere
decision: pencil down 4x, calls down ~30%; still the loudest event (commands should be hard)

saw: all six choices within 0.25 s on screen (largest +0.25 for stopping the backing, measured from ink motion; the swap itself +0.17); centroid never past 0.579 m; end 40% of the body inside the door frame, 44% of its ink in the lit doorway; approach 3.404 m measured vs 3.406 m score; 30 swaps, min hold 6 frames, all on twos
decision: end card still named a removed tree: fixed text and re-rendered

saw: each choice reads as a drawing change; at 28 s the head is in the lit doorway (dark lines) and the body outside (pale lines); the 7.8-14.7 s watch is a held drawing for 6.8 s
decision: stop: watchable, invariants hold; independent critic not run by this swarm
